text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Our nanny is hard at work, I hear. I
imagine it's
because our family is coming
together after so
long to celebrate your
birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right? I wish she
wouldn't—it's nothing
to get so excited
about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, can you blame her? Our parents
and other
relatives are taking time out
of their busy
schedules to be there, so
she wants to make it
special.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's just try to enjoy this time with our
precious
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Personally, I'm looking forward to
simply being
able to speak with you.
Perhaps we can reminisce
about old
times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm your sister. Would it be anything
else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All right. I suppose I should finally go
and show
my face at home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That would be nice. Mother and Father
are very
much looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of special events... will you be
preparing
any of the food there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you needn't worry. Nanny will be
personally
making all your favorites.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really? I'd like to have some of your
cooking
once in a while. It's light, like a
dusting of snow...
